name: list_skill_resources
description: List bundled resource files for an installed skill package (references/examples/scripts). Use proactively after `load_skill` to discover what reference material is available.
first_use_guidance:
Guidance for later list_skill_resources calls in this turn:
- At most 120 files are collected per call, so the reported total can undercount a larger bundle; a listing showing 120 files may be truncated.

category.description: Optional resource category. Omit to list all resources.
